title: Header Assignment
text: Update fields of ROS 2 message header, 1 input, 1 output; {Set Frame ID} sets the frame associated with message data, {Set Timestamp} sets the timestamp in header and {Header field name}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: InputMsg
ports.summary: ROS 2 message to update nonvirtual bus

ports.name: OutputMsg
ports.summary: ROS 2 message with an updated header nonvirtual bus

params.name: Set Frame ID
params.values: Specify frame associated with message data off (default) | on

params.name: Set Timestamp
params.values: Set timestamp in header off (default) | on

params.name: Header field name
params.values: Specify Header field name Use the default Header field name (default) | Specify your own
